shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100
for f in package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done
(npm install 2>&1 | tail -15) && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/ | head -50; grep -rl "Calendar\|DatePicker" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build --include=*.d.ts | head -20; grep -o "export {[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -c 500; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | head -80

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/* -d | grep -i "date\|calendar"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/unstable.d.ts; grep -rli "calendar" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head
npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | tail -40

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -30; for v in 4.0.0 3.0.0 2.0.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies dependencies 2>/dev/null; done; npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils version peerDependencies 2>/dev/null

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 peerDependencies dependencies 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 time.modified 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils@2 version 2>/dev/null | tail -3

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@2.7.3 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -5 && grep -A8 '"dependencies"' package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist | head -30

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/*/ | head -80

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components; cat $D/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/Calendar/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; ls $D/Calendar $D/DatePicker; echo ----; cat $D/DatePicker/DatePicker.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/index.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist; cat $D/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls $D/docs/components; cat $D/esm/components/DatePicker/hooks/datePickerStateFactory.d.ts | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types)"';
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/DatePicker.md | head -150; echo ======; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md | head -80

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView; cat $D/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts | head -60; cat $D/hooks/types.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts | head -30
grep -n "ValueBase" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/*.d.ts | head -40
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright; python3 -c "import playwright" 2>&1) | head; rm -rf dist; git status --short
